note: PLACEHOLDER. Written to make the sweep exercisable end to end, not to test the agent. Three questions against the seeded fixture org, chosen because each one reaches a different part of the turn: one that needs the priorities in the database, one that should reach the constituent-data tool, and one the agent should answer from its product knowledge without a tool call. Real case lists are Melecia's and there are 20 agents to write; the judge uses only the questions from a case file and ignores gold values, so the Chief of Staff evals/cases directory is the starting point for the real one. Replace this file rather than adding to it.

cases.question: What are my top priorities right now, and which one has been open the longest?
How many registered voters in my district are under 30?
How do I send a text message to my constituents?
